_comment: Promised vs delivered / Promis vs réalisé. Only pairs where BOTH the announced value and the actual (or latest official) value are stated in a cited source. Never estimate. type: cost|deadline|outcome. status: promised | in_progress | completed | delayed | unfulfilled (labels in _data/promise_status.json). delayed and unfulfilled REQUIRE status_evidence_en/fr + status_source_url/outlet/date: a cited source that states the delay or the failure; never infer it. Optional status_note_en/fr: one factual line shown under the badge. Validate with `python3 _tools/plain.py --strict`.
